initial_correction.purpose: Bind the active npm evidence and explicitly allow the fresh C1L evidence directory while preserving the C1J baseline, historical C1J output path, traversal rejection, and symlink rejection.

conditional_repair.limits: A repair must address observed C1L test or check failures without weakening assertions, thresholds, candidate coverage, traversal/symlink protections, or any fail-closed behavior. If the cause is outside the allowlist or checks still fail after this cycle, stop and report; require a separate gate for further edits.

product_check_scope: focused tests for scanner, dependency direction, and conversation resume fixture
coverage with thresholds statements >=90%, branches >=85%, functions >=90%, lines >=90%
candidate post-check, log sanitization, historical evidence integrity, command-record integrity
explicitly_not_authorized: any product path outside the three-file allowlist
reviewer creation or substitution; C1K reviewer attempts are spent
M07-S2, M07-S3, M07-S4, M05, or any downstream stage
database, network, external service, real data, sensitive action, or production operation
modification of C1J, C1K, or earlier historical evidence
threshold changes, weakening assertions, or broadening candidate package policy
result_boundary: C1L may establish a fresh local controlled result only. Even if all C1L criteria pass, M07-S1 remains FAIL / OPEN until its independent review criteria receive separate valid evidence and disposition.
